svg.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
svg.title: ScienceEvolve · Improve a scientific solver, in parallel.
svg.desc: Main delegates a Poisson solver improvement to Lead. Solver implements an FFT kernel while Tester checks convergence in isolated worktrees. Their PRs integrate into a group PR; Review verifies and merges the result, producing the convergence plot. Agent cards label their Harness: Codex, DSH or pi, preserving the depicted configuration across recovery and intentional version changes.
svg.text: Improve a scientific solver, in parallel.
